Box.doc: A flexbox container laid out by taffy; draws nothing itself.

column-gap.doc: Space between columns in points; null to use `gap`.

flex-wrap.doc: Whether children wrap onto more lines.

gap.doc: Space between children on both axes, in points (row-gap and column-gap override it).

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

row-gap.doc: Space between rows in points; null to use `gap`.

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws the button background and border.

selected.doc: Drawn as selected (a toggle look); clicking does not change it.

checked.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Checkbox widget writes checked into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Checkbox.doc: A check box with a caption.

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

open.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::CollapsingHeader (header) + taffy flexbox (body) widget writes open into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

CollapsingHeader.doc: A clickable header with a caret; its children (a flex box, indented) are shown and laid out only while `open`.

open.doc: Shows the children; a click on the header (or Enter/Space on it) toggles it.

text.doc: The header's caption (also its accessible name).

changed.doc: The user opened or closed it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

selected.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::ComboBox widget writes selected into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

ComboBox.doc: A drop-down list: shows the selected option, picks one from a popup. Name it with `accessible-name` (it has no caption).

hint-text.doc: Shown while `selected` is out of range.

options.doc: The choices, in order (the popup's rows).

selected.doc: Index of the chosen option; picking a row changes it. Out of range shows no text.

changed.doc: The user picked a row; carries its index.
changed.name: changed

Grid.doc: A CSS grid container laid out by taffy: children fill the cells row by row (auto-placement); draws nothing itself.

align-items.doc: Vertical alignment of each child in its cell.

column-gap.doc: Space between columns in points; null to use `gap`.

gap.doc: Space between rows and between columns, in points (row-gap and column-gap override it).

grid-template-columns.doc: The column tracks, CSS syntax: `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `<n>fr`, `<n>px` (or a bare number: points), `<n>%`, `minmax(a, b)`, `fit-content(<len>)`, `repeat(<n>, tracks)`. Rows are implicit (`auto`). The default is a form: a label column and a field column.

justify-items.doc: Horizontal alignment of each child in its cell.

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

row-gap.doc: Space between rows in points; null to use `gap`.

Icon.doc: A glyph from an icon font the embedder registered (SVP6), by name or as text. With `frame` it is an icon button. Its accessible name is `accessible-name`, else `tooltip`, else `name`.

family.doc: The registered font family (`egui::FontFamily::Name`) holding the glyphs; empty for the proportional family. A family with no fonts, a name not in its table or a glyph no font has draws an outlined placeholder box (`svelters_egui::fonts::FontWarning`).

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws it as a button (an icon button: role `Button`, takes focus).

glyph.doc: The glyph itself (text), when `name` is empty or not in the table.

name.doc: The glyph's name in the family's name table (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_icons`); also the default accessible name.

selected.doc: With `frame`: drawn as selected (a toggle look).

size.doc: Font size in points; null for the body size.

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

selectable.doc: The text can be selected and copied.

wrap-mode.doc: What a line longer than the width does (`egui::TextWrapMode`).

scroll-x.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::ScrollArea + taffy flexbox (content) widget writes scroll-x into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

scroll-y.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::ScrollArea + taffy flexbox (content) widget writes scroll-y into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

ScrollArea.doc: A flex box whose content scrolls when it overflows the area's size (taffy `overflow: scroll`); give it a size or let flex-grow size it.

direction.doc: The axes that scroll (taffy `overflow: scroll` on them).

scroll-x.doc: Horizontal offset in points; scrolling changes it, and a write scrolls (clamped to the content).

scroll-y.doc: Vertical offset in points; scrolling changes it, and a write scrolls (clamped to the content).

changed.doc: The user scrolled (or a write was clamped); carries the new offsets.
changed.name: changed

Separator.doc: A thin line between items; fills its rect along its orientation.

orientation.doc: A horizontal line (in a column) or a vertical one (in a row).

value.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Slider widget writes value into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Slider.doc: A horizontal slider with an optional value box.

show-value.doc: Shows the value box next to the slider.

value.doc: The value; dragging or the arrow keys change it.

changed.doc: The user moved it; carries the new value.
changed.name: changed

drag-started.doc: A drag on the slider began.
drag-started.name: drag-started

drag-stopped.doc: A drag on the slider ended.
drag-stopped.name: drag-stopped

text.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::TextEdit widget writes text into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

TextEdit.doc: A single- or multi-line text field.

request-focus.doc: Moves keyboard focus here on the next frame.

char-limit.doc: Maximum number of characters; 0 for none.

hint-text.doc: Shown while the text is empty; also the default accessible name.

multiline.doc: Several lines (`TextEdit::multiline`); Enter inserts a newline.

text.doc: The edited text; typing changes it.

changed.doc: The user edited the text; carries the new text (once per frame).
changed.name: changed

checked.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Button (selected) widget writes checked into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

ToggleButton.doc: A button that stays pressed (`checked`). With `radio`, a row of them is a segmented control: a click checks one, the app unchecks the rest.

checked.doc: Pressed state; a click toggles it (with `radio`, a click only sets it).

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws the button background and border.

radio.doc: One of a segmented group: a click checks it and never unchecks it (`Ui::selectable_value`); AccessKit role `RadioButton`. The app unchecks the others.

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

clicked.doc: Pressed and released (also when a `radio` click left it checked).
clicked.name: clicked

Widget.doc: Common properties of everything placed in a window: state, tooltip, accessibility and its taffy item style.

accessible-name.doc: AccessKit name (`Response::accessible_name`); inputs default to their hint or text.

align-self.doc: Cross-axis alignment in the parent box, overriding its `align-items`.

anchor.doc: A name unique in its embedded root: the node's egui id derives from it (stable across runs, not only across reorders), it is the AccessKit author id, and `Embed::anchor_rect` finds it. Changing it drops the node's egui memory.

enabled.doc: Takes input when true; drawn greyed out otherwise (`Ui::add_enabled`).

flex-basis.doc: Main-axis size before growing or shrinking; null for auto.

flex-grow.doc: Share of the parent's free main-axis space.

flex-shrink.doc: Share of the parent's main-axis overflow to give up.

height.doc: Height in points; null for auto.

invalid.doc: Marks the value as invalid: an outline in the error colour (`Visuals::error_fg_color`) and AccessKit `invalid`. The app sets it; the widget never does.

margin.doc: Outer spacing on all four sides, in points.

max-height.doc: Maximum height in points; null for none.

max-width.doc: Maximum width in points; null for none.

min-height.doc: Minimum height in points; null for auto.

min-width.doc: Minimum width in points; null for auto.

visible.doc: Shown and laid out when true (`display: none` otherwise).

width.doc: Width in points; null for auto.

Window.doc: A native window (the root viewport, or an immediate viewport); its children are laid out as a flex column.

close.doc: Closes the window as the user would (no close-request).

present.doc: Shows the window (the first one presented is the root viewport).

gap.doc: Space between the window's children, in points.

padding.doc: Inner spacing of the content area, in points.

close-request.doc: The user asked to close the window; return true to keep it open. Runs before the frame's pass.
close-request.name: close-request

px.provenance: egui points: 1px in a style sheet is one point
